baseline.test_policy: No test use for choosing weights

arms.name: A_dmin025
arms.hypothesis: Excess relative influence of distance regression on common non-conflict frames suppresses task balance.

arms.name: B_areq3
arms.hypothesis: Increasing braking-task contribution improves positive-demand regression without suppressing distance learning.

invariants: Do not renormalize coefficients to sum1
Same initial model and data order seed; no old weights
Keep collision shared reduction, Focal alpha/gamma, scales10/5, monotonicity0.1 and all detection weights
Keep radar, targets, masks, assignment, NMS, candidate set, sampler and optimizer unchanged
Separate output directories; no main source changes; no optimizer-state continuation between arms

comparison.primary_A: Three-horizon AP/Brier and critical detection, with danger dmin MAE retained as a guard
comparison.primary_B: MAE on valid areq>0 cohort, with zero-demand error, AP/Brier and detection as guards
comparison.motion: Report native matched ADE/FDE with counts AND compare common matched GT IDs at fixed epochs
comparison.checkpoint_selection: No per-arm cherry-picking a different best metric epoch; no sole val_loss or AP2 selection
comparison.acceptance: Target improvement plus no degradation of other key metrics is a candidate; tradeoffs are reported, not automatically called a win
comparison.statistics: Exploratory single-seed comparison; rare positive episodes and CUDA backward nondeterminism preclude a robustness claim

implementation_requirement: Expose native distance/brake loss overrides in an isolated runtime/config; update observer to record weighted per-dimension and total Risk gradients consistently; test unit multipliers reproduce baseline before any new training
